evidence: Has P2P label, modifies CConnman message queuing in src/net.cpp and src/net.h, and addresses private broadcast validation bypass in src/node/transaction.cpp.
rationale: Prevents out-of-bounds buffer writes and node aborts caused by unvalidated outbound message sizes. As noted in the description, 'V1 aborts on a longer type, while V2 sends a truncated type with the payload intact or writes past its encoding buffer', and unvalidated witness variants could bypass size limits into private broadcast queues.
